The audit's '226 tokens of headroom' is the PREFLIGHT operational margin measured by core.flight.cli check with its placeholder 4-bytes-per-token counter on the widest representative request; under the armed context_fit_policy compact-or-abstain a COMPACT_REQUIRED preflight with a non-negative PHYSICAL margin is recorded and proceeds (the AGREE and COMP-1 cells already read COMPACT_REQUIRED on the Solver), and only a negative physical margin refuses.
